title: Oxford Is Older Than the Aztec Empire 🎓 #shorts
description:
Teaching began at Oxford around 1096, more than two centuries before the Aztecs founded Tenochtitlan in 1325. Mind-blowing history!

#shorts #facts #crazyfacts #history #didyouknow

scenes.text: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
Teaching at Oxford was already happening in the year ten ninety-six.
scenes.label: YEAR

scenes.text: The Aztecs only founded their great city, Tenochtitlan, in thirteen twenty-five.
That means students were studying at Oxford for more than two hundred years before it even existed.
Oxford was already teaching long before the printing press was invented.
History is far weirder than we remember it.
